description: This file contains utility functions for string pattern matching, memory size parsing, number-to-string conversions, random ID generation, path handling, and internal tests, primarily used within the Redis project.

methods.name: stringmatchlen
methods.description: Performs glob-style pattern matching with support for wildcards, character classes, and escape sequences.

methods.name: stringmatch
methods.description: Simplified pattern matching function that calls stringmatchlen with string lengths.

methods.name: memtoll
methods.description: Converts a memory size string (e.g., '1Gb') into its byte equivalent.

methods.name: digits10
methods.description: Calculates the number of digits of a 64-bit unsigned integer in base 10.

methods.name: ll2string
methods.description: Converts a long long integer to its string representation, handling negatives.

methods.name: string2ll
methods.description: Parses a string into a long long integer, with overflow and format checks.

methods.name: string2l
methods.description: Parses a string into a long integer, ensuring no overflow.

methods.name: d2string
methods.description: Converts a double to a string, handling special cases like NaN and infinity.

methods.name: getRandomHexChars
methods.description: Generates a random hexadecimal string, using /dev/urandom or fallback entropy sources.

methods.name: getAbsolutePath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of a filename, resolving relative paths and '../' components.

methods.name: pathIsBaseName
methods.description: Checks if a path is just a filename without directory components.
